limits: This is a locally composed narrow slice of official components, not complete MainLayout parity.
No instance presence/status panel, private box, thread/reaction/profile actions, attachments, Task management or Role/instance management yet. Console retains these capabilities.
Message rows use the official read-only projection; text posting uses the official compact composer.
Directory is loaded on entry; new/renamed channels need page reload.
No end-to-end multi-agent browser acceptance is claimed.
Attachment/forward content has an explicit unavailable-preview notice; it is not silently rendered as an empty message.
This slice selects the first active workspace; workspace switching is not yet connected.
regressionsFoundAndFixed: Missing column container on narrow screens: now uses official flex-column composition and explicit geometry assertion.
Unmount discarded an unknown write: unresolved slots retained across history navigation.
Verification left previously sent content in the draft: the same original composer submission remains unresolved until verification succeeds.
